title: ebermaiera angustifolia
intro: Ebermaiera angustifolia, commonly known as Brazilian rosewood or Angelim da Terra, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ebenaceae. This plant is prized for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety and insomnia, as well as possessing anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Ebermaiera angustifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as sedation and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to interact with the GABA receptors in the brain, promoting relaxation and reducing stress.
